items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me '100% pistachio cream' to USDA Foundation 'Nuts, pistachio nuts, raw'. The ingredient explicitly states 100% pistachio, so grinding to a cream changes physical form without adding another ingredient. The target's own pinned evidence contains this exact FDC record and prior reviewed Cook4Me 'Pistachio' independently points to the same record. This review does not generalize to sweetened pistachio cream, pistachio spread, flavoring, added oil, dairy, or other formulated pistachio products.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Boiled milk' to USDA FNDDS 'Milk, NFS'. Boiling is a preparation state of milk and the target does not specify added ingredients or a particular fat percentage, so the generic milk-NFS record is the least assumptive available match. The target's own pinned evidence contains this exact FDC record and prior reviewed Cook4Me 'Milk' independently points to it. Confidence remains medium because the original milk fat percentage and degree of evaporation are unspecified; this review does not generalize to plant milk, chocolate milk, condensed milk, evaporated milk, or cream.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Chopped frozen mushrooms' to USDA FNDDS 'Mushrooms, raw'. Chopping is a physical preparation step and the target names mushrooms without sauce, oil, breading, stuffing, or another formulation. The target's own pinned evidence contains this exact FDC record and prior reviewed Cook4Me 'Chopped mushrooms'/'Mushrooms' independently point to the same generic mushroom record. Confidence remains medium because freezing and mushroom variety are not represented explicitly by the selected generic FNDDS record; this review does not generalize to fried, stuffed, pickled, dried, or sauced mushrooms.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Dried fruit mix (raisins, cranberries)' to USDA FNDDS 'Dried, fruit, NFS'. This is a mixed dried-fruit target and the selected FDC record is explicitly the generic dried-fruit-not-further-specified class, avoiding a false single-fruit binding. The target's own pinned evidence contains this exact record and prior reviewed Cook4Me 'Dried fruit' independently points to it. Confidence remains medium because the exact raisin/cranberry ratio and sweetening of the cranberries are not specified; this review does not generalize to fresh fruit, candied fruit, fruit paste, or a known single-fruit composition.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Frozen garlic' to USDA Foundation 'Garlic, raw'. The target identifies garlic without an added sauce, oil, seasoning, or other formulation, and freezing is treated here as preservation of the same food rather than a recipe transformation. The target's own pinned evidence contains this exact FDC record and prior reviewed Cook4Me 'Garlic' independently points to it. Confidence remains medium because the catalog wording does not prove whether the frozen garlic was commercially processed or had minor formulation changes; this review does not generalize to garlic paste, garlic oil, seasoned garlic, or garlic bread.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Red pointed pepper, halved and seeded
items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Red pointed pepper, halved and seeded' to USDA Foundation 'Peppers, bell, red, raw'. The target is an unprocessed raw red sweet pepper; halving and seeding are preparation-only changes. The target's own pinned evidence contains this exact FDC record and prior reviewed Cook4Me 'Red pepper' independently points to it. Confidence remains medium because a pointed sweet-pepper cultivar is not proven to be the exact bell-pepper cultivar represented by the USDA record; this review does not apply to hot, cooked, canned, dried, or pickled peppers.
